title: Austin Boosts Affordable Housing Projects
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors Regular Meeting
summary:
*   Approved increased funding for Austin Habitat for Humanity to provide permanent supportive housing for extremely low-income residents at 3300 Creek Drive.
*   Authorized an additional $1 million for LifeWorks to develop more affordable housing within the city.
*   All discussed housing projects were confirmed to be located inside Austin city limits.
